answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. What survives to the yarrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The saffron holds work receipts rather than names, so the wander of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
